{{Quote|Good day. I am Minister of Education for Narmle. For the upcoming "Great Conversation" debate between Narmle's leading scholars and those of Restuss, I've invited the illustrious thinker Ingon Lakbo. Would you be so kind as to pick up his response?|Sindra Lintikoor to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Ingon Lakbo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Historian/Legends|scholar]] and philosopher who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He resided in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]], on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], and was considered a great mind.

==Behind the scenes==
Ingon Lakbo was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
